_about: Layout v3 (New York Countdown), proposal by Claude 18 Nov 2026, not decided. Generated by tools/make_layout_nyc.py on geometry v2. Positions are +-1 m: they sit on values that are not measured yet.

holes.name: Bike Lane
holes.play: Five real bicycle wheels stand upright across a green bike lane in a zigzag. Thread the gaps or bank off the rail; spokes give a different bounce every time. A bike-rack hoop frames the cup.
holes.prop: Five old bike wheels (free from bike shops), bolted into timber cradles. A real bike bell on the totem: ring it when you hole out.
holes.robust: Wheels are cable-tied to their cradles so they can't turn or fall. Each wheel either touches the rail or leaves at least 0.4 m (9 balls wide), so a ball can't wedge. No power.
holes.clock: A bike computer on the first wheel reads 11:59.

holes.name: Hot Dog Cart
holes.play: Short and punchy, like the reference. Putt under a New York hot dog cart (the ball runs between its wheels), then round a giant hot dog that lies across the green as a bank wall and a heap of giant fries. Mustard and ketchup bottles stand either side of the cup.
holes.prop: Stainless-look cart with a striped umbrella (2.2 m), a 1 m hot dog, fries, two 0.6 m squeeze bottles.
holes.robust: The cart is screwed to the deck and the umbrella pole is clamped to the cart. Food props are foam on plywood bases screwed down. The gap under the cart is 0.2 m high and the full lane wide, so nothing jams.
holes.clock: The cart's menu board says "Open till 11:59".

holes.name: The Big Apple
holes.play: A 1.7 m apple stands across the lane. The only way through is the worm hole at its base, and two angled leaf boards funnel a good putt toward it. A miss comes back off the leaves for another go. The worm pokes out on the far side.
holes.prop: Thick cut-out apple: two plywood profiles 0.45 m apart, skinned and painted gloss red, with a boxed tunnel. Cartoon worm on the far side.
holes.robust: The tunnel is 0.32 m wide (7 balls) with a sloped floor, so a ball never stops inside; its top lifts off. The apple bolts to the deck through an L-frame. No moving parts.
holes.clock: The worm wears a watch at 11:59.

holes.name: Gridlock
holes.surface: Charcoal "asphalt" carpet, yellow lines, zebra crossing
holes.play: A traffic jam: eight chunky yellow cabs parked at angles across an asphalt lane, with traffic cones. The ball pinballs between them, so luck evens out skill and kids can beat adults. The cup sits past a zebra crossing, and a cab roof light flashes when you sink.
holes.prop: Cabs are painted timber blocks (360 × 170 × 140 mm) with a checker band and roof light. Cones and a New York street sign.
holes.robust: Cabs are screwed from below, so nothing gets knocked loose. Every gap is either closed or at least 0.25 m (6 balls wide), and inside corners are filled, so there's nowhere for a ball to get trapped. The light is battery-powered; the hole plays the same without it.

holes.name: Liberty Island
holes.surface: Green turf island, blue painted harbour
holes.play: Tee off from the pier and cross a 0.6 m ferry gangway over the harbour to a round island green. Miss the gangway and the ball drops into the harbour, which slopes back to the tee: no lost balls, just a retake. Liberty's torch arm rises 2.6 m over the island.
holes.prop: Verdigris torch arm (box-section plywood) leaning over the island, with a glowing flame. A small orange ferry in the harbour.
holes.robust: The harbour is a sloped channel 40 mm below the deck that returns every miss to the tee. The arm stands on its own weighted base behind the island, outside the play area, so nobody can lean on it. The flame LED is battery-powered.
holes.clock: The tablet at her base reads XI:LIX.

holes.name: The Subway
holes.sign: Stand Clear of the Closing Doors
holes.surface: Grey platform carpet with a yellow edge strip
holes.play: A white-tiled subway wall with three tunnels, each marked as a train line. The express drops you near the cup; the two locals come out further away. Choose your line. A subway car stands at the end of the platform with its destination sign lit.
holes.prop: Subway-tile wall with three arched tunnels and coloured line circles. A painted subway-car front (2.4 m) as the backdrop.
holes.robust: Tunnels are open boxes with lift-off lids and sloped exits, so no ball can stall inside. The wall and car front bolt to the deck frame.

holes.name: Rooftop
holes.play: Putt up the fire-escape ramp (1:6) to a rooftop green 200 mm up, where the cup sits right under a wooden water tower. Too soft and it rolls back to you; too hard and it bounces off the clear back guard.
holes.prop: A New York water tower (barrel on steel legs, 2.4 m) over the cup, and a brownstone façade with a zigzag fire escape and lit windows.
holes.robust: Clear guards on both sides and the back of the rooftop. The tower's legs stand outside the rails on their own base, and the barrel's underside is 1.4 m up, out of a putter's swing.

holes.name: The Rink
holes.surface: Short approach in turf, then a white "ice" rink (smooth white felt or laminate)
holes.play: A short approach onto a white rink that runs faster than turf, with rink boards to bank off. Three skaters glide slowly round on a turntable in the middle. Time it or go round. A soft touch wins.
holes.prop: A 3 m Christmas tree behind the rink (borrowed from the church's Christmas decorations), with a lit star. Skater cut-outs on the turntable.
holes.robust: The only moving part on the course, and it's optional: if the turntable stops, the skaters become fixed bumpers and the hole plays fine. The turntable sits flush with a 2 mm gap. Test the surface on the prototype; if laminate is too fast, use white felt.

holes.name: Grand Central
holes.play: Putt onto a giant clock-face green. The hands, stopped at 11:59, are fixed bumpers that split the green; the cup sits just past 12. The gold four-faced clock stands on its information booth at the edge of the green.
holes.prop: Four-faced brass clock with glowing faces on a round booth (1.9 m). Backdrop: a teal ceiling with gold constellations and arched windows.
holes.robust: The hands are 50 mm solid timber with rounded ends, screwed down. The clock and backdrop stand on their own bases outside the rails.

holes.name: Times Square
holes.play: The finale. Putt up and over the red steps, between glowing billboards, into the cup under the ball-drop tower. The cup keeps your ball (that's the end of the round), and the tower's ball lights up with a cheer.
holes.prop: A 3.6 m ball-drop tower with a glitter ball and lit 2027 numbers. Billboard flats either side of the lane. A neon-style "See you in 2027" sign.
holes.robust: The light and cheer are a bonus on a battery and microswitch: if they fail, the hole still plays and still collects the balls. The tower is a truss on a weighted, guyed base outside the rails.
holes.clock: The billboard clock shows 11:59. Optional: at midnight a volunteer lowers the glitter ball on a pulley in time with the stage countdown.
